answer: Require every agent to hold one active CPA license, verified live against its state board of accountancy registry by license number and name. Earning one takes 150 semester hours, four sections of the Uniform CPA Exam, and one to two years of supervised work — about five years and $3,000 in fees per identity. A forger wanting 1,000 puppets faces 5,000 years of schooling and $3 million, and each fake stands on a ledge over basalt: the board either holds the matching row or the identity falls. The kernel is the live lookup — no matching row, no market access.
